Prepare cells from your tissue of interest without lysing erythrocytes

Filter the cells with a 70 m cell strainer, centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes, and resuspend in an appropriate volume of MojoSortTM Buffer. Count and adjust the cell concentration to 1 x 108 cells/mL.

Aliquot 100 L of cell suspension (107 cells) into a new tube. Add 5 L of the biotin anti-human CD14 antibody, mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes. Optional: Take an aliquot before adding the antibody to monitor purity and yield.

Resuspend the Streptavidin Nanobeads by vortexing, maximum speed, 5 touches. Without washing, add 10 L of Nanobeads, mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes. Scale up the volume accordingly if separating more cells; for example, add 100 L for 1 x 108 cells. When working with less than 107 cells, use indicated volumes for 107 cells.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes, discard supernatant. Resuspend by flicking or in 100 uL of MojoSortTM buffer.

Resuspend the CD4 Nanobeads by vortexing, maximum speed, 5 touches. Add 10 L of Nanobeads, mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes. Scale up the volume accordingly if separating more cells; for example, add 100 L for 1 x 108 cells. When working with less than 107 cells, use indicated volumes for 107 cells.
